content.title: Everything we know about the new hockey romance Off Campus
content.text: There's a new hockey show in town! Off Campus is your new favourite hockey romance. Credit: Prime Video Your newest steamy hockey obsession is mere weeks away! Following the major success of Heated Rivalry, Off Campus, based on Ella Kennedy’s book series of the same name, will hit Prime Video on May 13. The good news? All eight episodes will drop at the same time, so there’s no waiting each week to see what happens next. More good news? If you’re a fan of the Off Campus books, you’ll be pleased to know that Ella has written over 50 contemporary fiction and romance novels, that’s a lot of books! What is Off Campus about? Off Campus is out on Prime Video on May 13. Credit: Prime Video Off Campus is a college soap, which follows “an elite ice hockey team, and the women in their lives, as they grapple with love, heartbreak, and self-discovery—forging deep friendships and enduring bonds while navigating the complexities that come with transitioning into adulthood”. Season one will focus on the “opposites attract” romance between quiet songwriter, Hannah (Ella Bright), and Garrett (Belmont Camelli), who is Briar University’s all-star athlete. “Off Campus captures the kind of emotionally charged, character-driven storytelling that truly resonates with our global Prime Video audience,” said Peter Friedlander, head of global television for Amazon MGM Studios. “With its passionate fan base, rich source material, and an incredible creative team bringing Briar U to life, we knew that this series had the depth and momentum to continue beyond its first season.” Off Campus is a college soap, which follows “an elite ice hockey team, and the women in their lives”. Credit: Prime Video He continued, “Set against the high-intensity world of college hockey, the series explores deeply personal journeys and is brought to life by a tremendously talented cast whose chemistry and authenticity make every moment feel real. “We have great confidence in the way [creator and co-showrunner Louisa Levy] has mastered this adaptation, and we’re excited to give fans even more of the romance, friendship, and heart that define the series.” Who stars in Off Campus? All eight episodes will drop at the same time. Credit: Prime Video Aside from leads Ella Bright and Belmon Camelli, other series regulars include Australia’s own Josh Heuston, who fans will know from Heartbreak High and Dune Prophecy, plus Mika Abdalla (Snack Shack, Sex Appeal), Antonio Cipriano (Pretty Little Liars: Original Sin, National Treasure: Edge of History), Jalen Thomas Brooks (The Pitt, Thanksgiving), and Stephen Kalyn (Gen V, Motorheads). Can I watch Off Campus’ trailer? The first teaser trailer dropped on Friday. Watch it here: When do episodes drop? The first season will be available to stream on May 13, 2026, only on Prime Video. You can sign up for Prime Video here. Will there be a second season of Off Campus? The great news is that the series has already scored itself an early renewal for season two! Variety revealed that the show had been renewed in February, months ahead of its season one release date. What book is Off Campus based on? The Off Campus TV series is based on the book series by the same name, written by Elle Kennedy. There are five books in the series: The Deal, The Mistake, The Score, The Goal, and The Legacy. If the show gets greenlit for five seasons, each season will follow each book, so the first season is based on The Deal, and so on. With a May release date, there’s still enough time to read the first book before season one comes out!
